# Unmodified Dill Acceptance

Target: the official **dill 0.4.1** Python package, without source changes.
Upstream: <https://github.com/uqfoundation/dill/releases/tag/0.4.1>.
The package is not vendored or installed into `Lib/`. Retain its BSD-3-Clause
license when obtaining an official distribution.

Run from the repository root, passing an absolute package installation directory
that contains `dill/` (or omit the argument when it is already importable):

```sh
.cache/build-clang21-ipo/cxxpython Tests/third_party/dill/test.py "$PWD/.cache/deps/dill-0.4.1-wheel"
```

`stdout.bin` is generated by fixed CPython 3.12.14 running this same script. It
covers ordinary values, graph identity/cycles, code reconstruction, function
defaults, closures, recursive globals, class instances, bound methods and arrays.
This is a separate opt-in third-party acceptance test, not a default CTest
fixture. Do not modify dill, inject substitute modules or invoke host CPython
to execute guest code to make it pass.

Run the distribution's own unchanged scripts, in real __main__ namespaces:

```sh
python3 Tests/python/test_dill.py --binary .cache/build-clang21-ipo/cxxpython
```

Use repeated `--case test_functions.py` arguments to select individual scripts.
The runner reports timeouts and nonzero exits; it does not rewrite tests or
inject missing dependencies. Optional dependencies skipped by upstream tests
are not established support. Compatibility work must preserve the shared-heap,
no-GIL, precise-root and thread-state contracts.

The retained package, diagnostics and earlier probe are under ignored
`.cache/deps/dill-0.4.1-wheel` and `.cache/dill-compatibility`. Only a complete
round trip through the product interpreter and subsequent upstream test coverage
may establish support. CPython bytecode and extension ABI compatibility are not
implied by this target.
